data.title: 4 Days in Rio de Janeiro
route: Sugar Loaf Mountain and Urca Hill
data.priceNote: From USD 1,255 per person sharing a triple room (TRP) at B&B Copacabana 3★. Double occupancy (DBL) starts at USD 1,447. All nine 2027 rates are shown in the table.

data.lead: Discover the highlights of Rio de Janeiro, from its iconic landmarks and spectacular viewpoints to its legendary beaches and vibrant neighbourhoods: a perfect short escape to experience the energy and beauty of the Marvellous City, either as a standalone getaway or as an extension to a South American journey.

itinerary.title: Welcome to the Marvellous City
itinerary.text:
Upon arrival at Rio de Janeiro International Airport, meet your local guide and enjoy a private transfer to your hotel. The rest of the day is at leisure to relax after your journey or begin exploring the vibrant atmosphere of Rio de Janeiro at your own pace.

Optional evening experience, at an additional cost: the Rio by Night show with dinner (see Optional excursions).

images.alt: The patterned Copacabana promenade and beach lined with palm trees in golden light, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

itinerary.title: Sugar Loaf Mountain & City Tour
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, a half-day excursion to one of Rio de Janeiro’s most famous landmarks. The tour begins with a cable car ride to Sugar Loaf Mountain, stopping first at Urca Hill before continuing to the summit. From the top, enjoy spectacular panoramic views of Guanabara Bay, Copacabana Beach, the surrounding mountains, the islands scattered along the coast, the Rio–Niterói Bridge and the iconic statue of Christ the Redeemer in the distance.

The excursion continues through the historic centre of Rio de Janeiro, with its colonial buildings, churches and monasteries and the impressive Metropolitan Cathedral, revealing the city’s rich history and cultural heritage. The rest of the afternoon is at leisure: relax on the beach, stroll along the famous promenades of Copacabana or Ipanema, or simply soak up the vibrant atmosphere of the Marvellous City.

images.alt: Panoramic view of Rio de Janeiro with Guanabara Bay, Sugar Loaf Mountain and the city, Brazil

itinerary.title: Corcovado & Christ the Redeemer
itinerary.text: Day 3 · After breakfast, a half-day excursion (4 hours) through the lush Tijuca Forest, one of the largest urban forests in the world, home to an extraordinary variety of tropical flora and fauna, to the summit of Corcovado Mountain, where the magnificent Christ the Redeemer overlooks the city. Named one of the New Seven Wonders of the World, the monument offers breathtaking panoramic views of Rio de Janeiro, its famous beaches, mountains and Guanabara Bay. Optional afternoon experience, at an additional cost: a private tour of Rocinha (see Optional excursions).

images.alt: View of Rio de Janeiro and Corcovado Mountain

itinerary.title: Departure from Rio de Janeiro
itinerary.text: Day 4 · After breakfast, free time until your scheduled private transfer to Rio de Janeiro International Airport. End of services.

images.alt: Rocky shoreline and sailboats in Guanabara Bay, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

## Hotels and prices for 2027

Price per person in USD for a 4-day / 3-night programme. All options include three nights in Rio de Janeiro, breakfast and the services specified in the itinerary. Hotels may be replaced by similar properties in the same category.

| Category | Hotel and room | SGL | DBL | TRP |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 3★ | B&B Copacabana, Superior Room + BB + Services | $2,607 | $1,447 | $1,255 |
| 4★ | Windsor Leme, Standard Room + BB + Services | $2,847 | $1,620 | $1,591 |
| 5★ | Miramar by Windsor, Standard Room + BB + Services | $3,219 | $1,912 | $1,755 |

## A short introduction to Rio

Two guided excursions, each lasting four hours, leave time to relax and explore independently. The Sugar Loaf cable car offers views of Copacabana and Guanabara Bay. On the next day, the route through Tijuca Forest leads to Corcovado and Christ the Redeemer.

This programme can be booked as a standalone short break or added to a longer South American itinerary. The Rio by Night show with dinner and the Rocinha community tour are optional experiences at an additional cost.
